title: Research Capstone for Social Data Science
description:
Prerequisite: Minimum grade of C- in BSOS326 or SDSB326, INST327, INST366, SURV400 or SDSB340, and INST414 or SDSI414.
Restriction: Must be in Social Data Science program; and must have earned a minimum of 90 credits; and permission of INFO-College of Information Studies.
Credit only granted for: INST490, SDSI492 or SDSI496.
